what: Shard-count validation discards the parsed `of N` total and uses only max parsed shard id
scenario_or_breakage: A valid 4-shard `python-tests` run can be rejected when shard 4 has no parseable `call` duration rows, while rows from shards 1-3 still say `shard X of 4`; `/rebalance-tests --kind python/all` then aborts before writes even though CI runs 4 shards
suggested_fix: Carry the total from `shard X of N` into `PytestTimingRow` or a helper; have `observed_shard_count` prefer the unique parsed `N`, fail on conflicting totals, and use max shard id only as fallback

what: The partition-failure test expects no `python/shard-assignments.json` on disk even though the plan adds that file as checked-in content
scenario_or_breakage: On `--kind all` partition failure, the correct behavior is to leave the checked-in `{}` or prior content unchanged; following the test text can force deletion of a tracked file or make the test fail against the proposed repo state
suggested_fix: Change the test and wording to assert the assignments file is not written or changed; preserve original content, and in absent-file fixtures assert the writer was not called rather than requiring repo-path absence
